recipes.name: Tempeh Tacos with Cashew Lime Cream
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat. Cook the shallots and garlic for 2 minutes.
Crumble the tempeh into the pan with your hands and cook for 6 to 7 minutes, stirring until lightly golden. Add splashes of water as needed to deglaze the pan.
Meanwhile, make the cashew cream by adding the ingredients to a small food processor. Blend until smooth. Add more water if needed to achieve your desired consistency.
Returning to the pan with the tempeh, add the spices and toast for 30 seconds. Then add the diced tomato and soy sauce, cooking for 3 to 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the tortillas on a skillet. Spoon the tempeh it onto the warmed tortillas, top with tomatoes, avocado slices, and onions. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use pure ground chili powder made from dried chili peppers - not to be confused with the chili powder spice blend commonly found in the US, which often includes cumin, garlic powder, and other seasonings. For the intended heat and flavour, be sure to use pure chili powder. † Our small tortillas measure about 6 inches (15 cm) in diameter.
Storage Store the filling in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
